product.description: These desktops can be used to complete Monoprice™ electric motorized and manual crank sit‑stand desk frames. Get a full height adjustable work surface that lets you effortlessly move your entire desk up or down. There is enough room for a PC or laptop, monitors, keyboard, a mouse, and other desk essentials. Two colors in three available sizes provide flexibility to fit your space and decor.Features: This desktop can be mounted on Monoprice™ Sit-Stand Desk FramesAvailable in three sizes (48, 60, 70 models) and two colors (black and white) to fit most space, design, and budget constraints47.0" x 29.5" rectangular desktop with 1 inch thicknessClassic white colorShips to your doorstep to avoid the hassle of driving home with an unwieldly table topShipping Box Dimensions: 51.3" x 34.0" x 3.0"Shipping Box Weight: 40.0 lbs.Assembled Dimensions: 29.5" x 47.0" x 1.0" SIT-STAND DESK FRAME OPTIONSThis desktop is designed to be mounted onto Sit-Stand desk frames, allowing you to choose from a range of Worksteam™ Sit-Stand desk frames. Simply drill mounting holes into the desktop and secure it in place with screws.
